_comment: Counted ingredients (no weight or volume) that only come whole. 'not_scaled': left at the recipe's amount with the note, since a fraction of one means a different pan, not more of it (decided 2026-11-16; may change with feedback). 'whole_units': rounded to a whole number, at least 1, with a note when that changes it by more than a tenth. 'rough_units': rounded the same way with no note, they're rough to begin with. Keywords are matched as whole words (plural allowed) against the unit and the ingredient part of the name (before the first comma).

not_scaled.note: Not scaled: a crust doesn't come in fractions. More or less filling usually means a bigger or smaller pan (or a second crust), depending on the pans you have.
